finding.headline: "The £370 Mistake"
finding.problem: "I bought the pretty one everyone on Instagram had. My baby screams in it. I can't return it. I just wanted to wear my baby like the pictures."
finding.person: Diaspora mum who bought a trendy £370 Artipoppe carrier pre-birth; newborn hated it; now ₦/£300 down the drain (The Sun case study).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (carrier-buying guide) / Angle for A1.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
